native_prose.review: stratified_source comparison; reject suspicious units; no independent proof of every textbook claim required for RAG

native_pdf.review: compare sampled ordinary pages and every flagged page with rendered originals

math.review: every equation used in a released SFT answer or relied-on RAG chunk compared to source; independently verify SFT reasoning

ocr.review: visual comparison required; confidence score alone is insufficient

table_multicolumn.review: retain structured cells or quarantine; flattened text is not accepted as a faithful table

visual_dependency.review: visual-dependent answers stay withheld until required visual evidence is reviewed; image links alone do not establish interpretation

sft_review: complete question, independently verified answer, explicit assumptions/units, all dependencies, family isolation, rights and mask proof
rag_review: faithful extraction with reliable citations and dependencies, privacy/rights/family isolation; not an SFT answer-key certification
evaluation_review: verified task/reference/grader, independent family, private destination, no SFT or retrieval leakage
sampling_accuracy_claim: only after prespecified random stratified review with item-weighted estimates and uncertainty; targeted examples cannot estimate corpus accuracy
